title: Design: opening the New Matrix category list keeps the tabs and grid in place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Matrix.
  3. Take a screenshot of the page.
  4. Click the Categories picker.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Matrix page opens.

Step 3:

  • The screenshot is saved.

Step 4:

  • The category list opens with a search box and Select all.
  • Compared with the screenshot, the Work Order Matrix and Part Sale Matrix tabs and the grid keep their place: nothing moves sideways or down.
